label: Gold will rise, and the sequoia seed opens only in fire
description: Given together in December 2023: that gold will rise, and an instruction to focus on the giant sequoia in California, whose seed does not open until fire comes upon it. Believers are told they will be like the sequoia rooting deep, with a fire coming upon the land.

label: A Solomon-like endowment of wisdom to rebuild America
description: A figure seen given a Solomon-like endowment of wisdom from the Father, gathering the pieces of something wrecked the way an architect rebuilds a destroyed rocket ship or a boat, in an attempt to build America back. The figure is not named in the telling.
